name: Future Mod
description: Skip level endings with a key, plus a per-level macro recorder with an automatic frame-perfect analyzer.

skip-end.name: Exit Level Ending
skip-end.description: Press this while a level is finishing to instantly exit the level, skipping the end animation, the delay, and the completion screen. The level still counts as completed. Only active during the ending, so it's safe to set to your jump key (e.g. Space).

macro-enabled.name: Enable Macro Features
macro-enabled.description: Master switch for everything macro-related (recording, playback, the frame-perfect analyzer, the in-level menu, and the HUD). Turn this OFF to fully disable all macro functionality; the 'Exit Level Ending' keybind is unaffected.

macro-record.name: Macro: Record
macro-record.description: Toggle recording your inputs as a step-indexed macro. Because it indexes by physics step (not time), recording while the game is slowed down by other mods still captures clicks correctly. Recording restarts on death, so it captures the attempt you actually complete.

macro-play.name: Macro: Play
macro-play.description: Toggle replaying the recorded macro from the start of the attempt.

macro-analyze.name: Macro: Analyze frame perfects
macro-analyze.description: Run the frame-perfect analyzer on the recorded macro. It shifts each input +/- a few ticks, re-runs, and measures each input's timing window. Turn OFF noclip and speedhack before running.

analyze-speed.name: Analyzer speed-up
analyze-speed.description: How fast to run the analysis. The analyzer tries this speed, and if a sped-up baseline doesn't reproduce your real 1x run tick-for-tick it automatically steps down (8x->4x->2x->1x) until it finds the fastest speed that stays exact. So a higher number is safe: it only ever speeds things up when it's provably identical to 1x. Long levels benefit most. For the biggest levels also enable 'Fast analysis'.

analyze-releases.name: Analyze releases too
analyze-releases.description: Also measure the timing window of RELEASES (letting go), not just presses. Wave/ship straight-flying is mostly release timing. Roughly doubles the analysis time.

analyze-fast.name: Fast analysis (EXPERIMENTAL)
analyze-fast.description: Snapshots the game state before each input and restarts probes from there instead of replaying the whole level every time, so long levels analyze far faster (near-linear instead of quadratic). Every snapshot is first VERIFIED by re-running it unshifted and comparing against the baseline trajectory; any snapshot that drifts is discarded and that input falls back to the normal full-replay method automatically. EXPERIMENTAL: if counts still look wrong, compare with this OFF.

show-240.name: Show 240 FPS
show-240.description: Display the frame-perfect count at 240 (window <= 1 tick).

show-120.name: Show 120 FPS
show-120.description: Display the frame-perfect count at 120 (window <= 2 ticks).

show-60.name: Show 60 FPS
show-60.description: Display the frame-perfect count at 60 (window <= 4 ticks).

ghost-fidelity.name: Ghost fidelity probe
ghost-fidelity.description: DIAGNOSTIC. Every 120 ticks of normal play, simulate a copy of the player 60 ticks ahead and compare it against what you actually do. Writes [fw] GHOSTFID lines to geode.log and a PHASE1 ... VERDICT=PASS/FAIL line when you die or quit. This decides whether the new frame-window counter can measure sub-frame windows at all. Costs nothing visually; turn it off when you're done testing.

ghost-order.name: Ghost step order
ghost-order.description: Which reconstruction of GD's physics step the simulation uses. GD's real internal ordering can't be read from the game, so this is tested by trial: run the fidelity probe once on each of 0, 1 and 2 and keep whichever gives the smallest maxdx. 0 = collide, move, rotate (what every other trajectory mod uses). 1 = move, collide, rotate. 2 = collide, move, special, rotate.

ghost-eps.name: Ghost tolerance (units)
ghost-eps.description: How far the simulated player may drift from the real one before it counts as diverged. Used by the fidelity probe's divergeAt column.

timestamp-probe.name: Timestamp clock probe
timestamp-probe.description: DIAGNOSTIC. Logs 100 [fw] TSPROBE lines at the start of a level showing the game's internal input timestamp. Answers one question: whether GD's own between-steps input path can be driven at an exact sub-tick time, which would let windows be measured below one frame in the real engine. One run is enough, ever.

log-verbose.name: Verbose logging
log-verbose.description: Write per-tick detail to geode.log. Very noisy; only enable when asked for a detailed log.
